title: Ordinary Differential Equations
text:
Welcome to Ordinary Differential Equations!
I am delighted to have you in this course. Throughout the semester, we will develop the mathematical theory of ordinary differential equations while emphasizing intuition, analytical techniques, and applications arising in science, engineering, and other quantitative disciplines.
This website will serve as the main hub for the course. Here you will find lecture notes, Jupyter notebooks, assignments, announcements, and additional resources. Please check this page regularly, as course materials and updates will be posted throughout the semester.
I encourage you to ask questions, participate actively in class, and enjoy the process of learning. I look forward to a productive and enjoyable semester together. Welcome!
